mainEntity.name: How Does a Robotic Palletizer Handle SKU or Pallet Pattern Changeovers?

acceptedAnswer.text: A changeover usually means selecting a stored recipe that holds the case dimensions, pick logic and pallet pattern for the new SKU. When the new case fits the same end-of-arm tool, the change happens mostly in software. TRFCobot supports multiple recipes and pallet patterns, which is why it fits high-mix lines with frequent changeovers.

mainEntity.name: What Floor Space and Reach Do I Need to Validate Before Buying a Cobot Palletizer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Validate the area for the robot, the infeed pick point, one or more pallet positions and operator access to remove full pallets. Then confirm reach: the robot must place the farthest case on the top layer of your tallest pallet. Pallet height and case size change the answer, so TRF validates reach, end-of-arm tool and pallet pattern for each application.
